fields.name: kyc_program_id
docs: KYC program address that owns the KycController account.
We must store this in case this program were to upgrade and
use a different KYC program in the future.

fields.name: admin
docs: Address with full authority over DeltaManager admin instructions.
In our case, this would be set to an AccessController for enforcing
role based access control.

fields.name: collateral_vault
docs: Token2022 Account that holds the asset as collateral

fields.name: delta_vault
docs: Token2022 Account that holds DELTA token

fields.name: clawback_token_recipient
docs: Address that receives clawed back tokens to an owned token account

fields.name: collateral_mint
docs: The SPL Token2022 mint address that this Asset accepts as collateral

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: The address which owns the token account(s) where fees are sent

fields.name: current_mint_amount
docs: DELTA amount already minted or reserved against the epoch `mint_limit`

fields.name: current_epoch
docs: Epoch that contract is currently in

fields.name: epoch_duration
docs: Duration of an epoch in seconds

fields.name: current_epoch_start_timestamp
docs: Timestamp of the start of `current_epoch`

fields.name: contract_start_timestamp
docs: Timestamp of the contract start

fields.name: last_set_mint_exchange_rate
docs: `exchangeRate` at start of `current_epoch`

fields.name: current_redeem_amount
docs: Amount already redeemed during the `current_epoch`

fields.name: minimum_deposit_amount
docs: Minimum amount that must be deposited to mint DELTA.
Denoted in decimals of `collateral`

fields.name: mint_fee
docs: Minting fee specified in basis points

fields.name: exchange_rate_delta_limit
docs: Limit for how far `exchangeRate` can stray from
`lastSetMintExchangeRate` within an epoch (in basis points)

fields.name: minimum_redeem_amount
docs: Minimum amount that must be redeemed for a withdraw request

fields.name: minimum_redeem_amount_fiat
docs: Minimum amount that must be redeemed for a withdraw request in fiat

fields.name: mint_limit
docs: Maximum DELTA amount that can be minted during an epoch

fields.name: redeem_limit
docs: Maximum amount that can be redeemed during an epoch

fields.name: base
docs: PDA seed pubkey to add randomness to derived address

fields.name: flags
docs: Admin flags, which can currently be used to pause the AssetController.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed of PDA
